data.one_liner: A non-interactive Cupertino-style progress bar for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A non-interactive progress bar that includes a track filling from left to right to show task progression with a known duration. Supports customization of track and fill colors.
use_when: You need a Cupertino-style progress bar for tasks with a quantifiable, well-defined duration
You want to display progression in iOS or cross-platform applications matching Apple design guidelines
avoid_when: You need an interactive slider or control
The task does not have a quantifiable duration (use an activity indicator instead)
strengths: Provides a native-feeling Cupertino progress bar widget
Allows custom colors for both the track and fill portions
